title: DriveWorld3D Evidence Constrained 3D World Modeling and Generative Simulation for Real-World Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.22450v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Three dimensional modeling for autonomous driving must continuously estimate road geometry, obstacle occupancy, traffic participant behavior, and observational uncertainty under limited computational resources. Existing reconstruction methods can synthesize realistic novel views, but visual fidelity does not sufficiently characterize the geometric reliability required for driving. Generative world models can expand scenarios and predict future observations, yet may introduce content unsupported by measurements. We propose DriveWorld3D, a framework combining temporal video learning, measurement constraints from multiple sensors, and offline generative simulation. Its online component maintains a unified world state comprising road surfaces, volumetric occupancy, dynamic entities, and road relations, while separately representing physical occupancy, observability, and evidence provenance. translated_title: DriveWorld3D：面向真实世界自动驾驶的证据约束三维世界建模与生成式仿真
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶的三维建模必须在有限的计算资源下持续估计道路几何、障碍物占据、交通参与者行为以及观测的不确定性。现有的重建方法虽然能够合成逼真的新视角，但视觉保真度不足以刻画驾驶所需的几何可靠性。生成式世界模型虽然能够扩展场景并预测未来观测，却可能引入测量数据无法支持的内容。我们提出DriveWorld3D，这是一个结合时序视频学习、多传感器测量约束与离线生成式仿真的框架。其在线组件维护一个统一的世界状态，包含路面、体积占据、动态实体和道路关系，并将物理占据、可观测性和证据来源分别进行表示。动作条件下的未来预测与风险敏感……
tldr: DriveWorld3D提出了一种证据约束的三维世界建模框架，通过融合时序视频学习、多传感器测量约束与离线生成式仿真，在统一世界状态中显式区分物理占据、可观测性与证据来源，为真实世界自动驾驶提供几何可靠的状态估计与风险感知的未来预测。
en_tdlr: DriveWorld3D is an evidence-constrained 3D world modeling framework that combines temporal video learning, multi-sensor measurement constraints, and offline generative simulation, explicitly representing physical occupancy, observability, and evidence provenance in a unified world state to enable geometrically reliable estimation and risk-aware prediction for real-world autonomous driving.
